verdict.rationale: Phaser is a JavaScript game framework/library, not an agent or application with a tool-using runtime — the evidence shows Phaser ships an MCP *server* (exposing its own editor/build tools to external agents like Claude, Cursor, Copilot), which is the opposite direction from the story (this product consuming external MCP servers as a client). There is no agent runtime in Phaser itself that could plug in and call external MCP tools, so this axis is a category error for this kind of product.
